entity: FEMA's lag from disaster declaration to first Federal Register notice, Jan-Jun 2025
why: PolitiFact gives a number for FEMA delay, over a month on average, but it measures request-to-approval time, not declaration-to-publication, a different definition, so it can't be lined up with our 110-day median. The FR notices (0-2) are the raw late records themselves; they carry the dates but state no finding about lateness.
